# AiMessage

An assistant reply, marked as AI by the small AI icon at its start (named "AI" for assistive technology), so no answer reads as a person's. Text is Markdown: paragraphs, lists, headings, code, bold, italic and links. The content is `text`, or `parts` when a reply mixes text with other content: a part is `{ type: 'text', text }` or any other `{ type, ... }`, which `renderPart` draws. - `status="complete"` is a finished message. - `status="streaming"` is text still arriving: a caret follows the last character and the message is marked busy for assistive technology. - `status="thinking"` is the typing indicator, before any text exists. `sources` lists what a finished answer read, folded under the message behind one toggle: the answer links what it names in its own text, so the list is there to check, not to read. `onFeedback` puts thumbs up and down under a finished answer; `feedback` holds the rating when the page owns it.

**Import:** `import { AiMessage } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/labels/AiMessage/AiMessage.jsx`

## Usage

Use `AiMessage` for every AI reply, in chat, a panel or elsewhere. Choose its
status from the table below.

### Status guidance

| Status | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Thinking | From the moment a message is sent until the first text arrives. The typing indicator, with no text. |
| Streaming | While text arrives. A caret follows the last character, and the message is busy for assistive technology. |
| Complete | The default: a finished reply. Only a complete reply shows its sources and its thumbs. |

## Motion

AiMessage reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does | Sound |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Load content | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Sources fade in place 20 ms apart, each tied to real work; the answer streams in chunks with no fade. |  |
| ready | Load content | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Feedback fades in over its Spinner. | `sound.ai.ready` on land: the feedback took over 1 s, so a Spinner showed |
| strong | Load content | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Strong feedback fades in over its Spinner. | `sound.ai.strong` on land: the feedback took over 1 s, so a Spinner showed |
| refine | Load content | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Refine feedback fades in over its Spinner. | `sound.ai.refine` on land: the feedback took over 1 s, so a Spinner showed |

## Best practices

### Stream the answer, then settle. {#stream-the-answer-then-settle}

Keep progress visible rather than leaving a blank; follow the status sequence
in Usage.

Do: The typing indicator, then the streaming state, shows the answer arriving.
Don't: Partial text shown as finished hides that it is still being written.

### List the sources whenever an answer draws on records. {#list-the-sources-whenever-an-answer-draws-on-records}

An answer built from sessions, students or reports passes them as `sources`,
so a person can open what the AI read. A general answer that read nothing
shows no list.

Do: The records the answer read, listed under it.
Don't: An answer from records with nothing to open.

### Offer feedback on every finished answer. {#offer-feedback-on-every-finished-answer}

Pass `onFeedback` for every answer; feedback appears only at `complete`, so
partial replies cannot be rated. See AI feedback
for rating changes and the optional, skippable comment.

Do: Thumbs under a finished answer.
Don't: A finished answer with no way to rate it.

## Accessibility

- **Marked as AI.** The AI icon at the start of every reply is an image named
  "AI", so a screen reader hears whose answer it is. Don't add a second icon
  beside the message.
- **Sources and feedback.** See AI sources
  for list naming and toggle semantics, and AI feedback
  for rating names, pressed states, focus and announcements.
- **Busy while arriving.** A streaming message is marked `aria-busy`, so a
  screen reader waits for the finished text. A typed-out reply carries its full
  text for assistive technology and hides the character-by-character copy.
- **Announced indicator.** The typing indicator is a status named "AI is writing";
  its dots are hidden from assistive technology.
- **Reduced motion.** The caret and dots stop animating, and typed-out text
  shows at once.

## Parts

1. **AI icon.** The small AI icon at 16, named "AI", centered on the first line, so no answer reads as a person's.
2. **Text.** The body style, keeping the reply's line breaks. With `parts`, text parts and other parts in order; `renderPart` draws a part that is not text.
3. **Caret.** Streaming only: a thin bar after the last character, blinking.
4. **Typing indicator.** Thinking only: three pulsing dots in place of the text.
5. **Sources** (optional). Complete only: a counted "Sources" toggle, closed by default, with linked titles and types inside.
6. **Feedback** (optional). Complete only, with `onFeedback`: thumbs up and down and a quiet thanks beside them.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Complete | The text, then the sources and the thumbs when they are passed. With `typeOut`, the text types out character by character (`TypingText` takes `speed`, in milliseconds per character, and `onComplete`). `linkTarget` sets where links open, such as `_top` from inside a frame, and `resolveHref` rewrites a link's address. |
| Streaming | A caret follows the last character, and the message carries `aria-busy`. No sources and no thumbs yet. |
| Thinking | The typing indicator, a status named "AI is writing", in place of the text. |
| Reduced motion | The caret and dots stop animating, and typed-out text shows at once. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Text | `--body-default` in `--ds-text`. |
| Icon to text | `--inline-md`; the icon centers on the first line against `--icon-md`. |
| Between parts | `--stack-md`. |
| Typing dots | `--ds-text-subtle`, `--radius-full`, `--stack-sm` apart. |
| Caret and dots motion | `--ds-motion-loop`, with the dots offset by a quarter and a half cycle. |
| Sources | Heading `--heading-xxsmall` in `--ds-text-subtle`; type `--body-small` in `--ds-text-subtle`; rows `--stack-sm` apart. |
| Feedback | Thanks `--body-small` in `--ds-text-subtle`; buttons `--inline-sm` apart. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name a source by its record: "Session notes, Oct 24", with its type, "Session". | Name a source by its address. |
| Put a table or a list the reply needs in a part that `renderPart` draws. | Draw a table out of characters inside the text. |
| Let the AI icon mark the reply. | Add a second icon beside the message. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `text` | string | — | A single text reply; shorthand for one text part. |
| `parts` | arrayOf (required) | — | Parts of a reply, in order: `{ type: 'text', text }` or another `{ type }` that `renderPart` draws. |
| `status` | enum | `'complete'` | `complete` is finished, `streaming` is text still arriving, `thinking` is the typing indicator. |
| `typeOut` | bool | `false` | Types a finished text out character by character, as a reply that has just arrived. |
| `renderPart` | func | — | Draws a part that is not text: `(part, index) => node`. |
| `sources` | arrayOf (required) | — | What a finished answer read: one `{ title, href, type }` per source, listed under the message. |
| `linkTarget` | string | — | Where the reply's links and its source links open, such as `_top` from inside a frame. |
| `resolveHref` | func | — | Rewrites a link's address in the reply's text: `(href) => href`, such as a docs page named by its title. |
| `onFeedback` | func | — | Thumbs up and down under a finished answer: called with `{ rating }`, or `{ rating: 'down', comment }`. |
| `feedback` | enum | — | The rating, when the page owns it: `up`, `down` or null. |
| `className` | string | — | — |

## Variants

**`status`** — `complete` · `streaming` · `thinking`

**`feedback`** — `up` · `down`

The named string values each prop takes. A prop's full type is in Props: a prop listed here may also take a boolean or a number, and a prop missing here may still have named values.
